Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J40/J40nB488.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dounan Wei. Dounan Wei owns the retained ask-and-verse: right at this moment at home not leaving the road — the on-the-road never-leaving-home line, how does it go? Senses.Explanation: The never-leaving-home of the Chan records: the founder's road pair — answered with eyes southeast and mind northwest, the white moon scooped from the pool and the Yellow River crossed in dream, worn as the road being home, asked who that one is, and bound into guest and host. Songyuan Chongyue raises the founder's pair — one on the road for whole aeons, never leaving home; one has left home, not on the road — which of the two deserves the offering of gods and men? — and answers: eyes on the southeast, mind on the northwest, Baiyu Jingsi at the Yongfeng hermitage hall adds one more: one always on the road, never leaving home; never leaving home, always on the road — and who is that one? a glance right and left, one shout, descending, Gulin Qingmao fires the pyre verse for his short-stayed attendant — living is putting on the shirt, dying taking off the trousers, the attendant's Chan never given over in words: on the road not leaving home, at home not leaving the road; fire hot and wind stirring, water wet and earth firm — and Huigong Kaixiong answers the ask that quotes the founder's line: asked the one sentence of never-leaving-home — scooping the white moon from the pool; asked the staying-home-yet-on-the-road line — crossing the Yellow River in dream. Meixi Fudu at his leave-taking of the hall: the way-man's walking is like a crane, like a cloud — stopping when he will, going when he will; how far apart are walking and staying? Grasp it and you grasp — never leaving home, always on the road; always on the road, never leaving home — fail, and two straw sandals fierce as a tiger, one bamboo staff alive as a dragon, Yuan'an Liao binds guest and host by it: playing guest, he roams the lakes and seas, yet never leaves home; showing host, he sits cross-legged on heaven and earth — what harm in mixing among the crowd? — then asks the word-free one-line, Chisong Daoling at the carving of his late teacher's record into the canon — one always on the road never leaving home, one never leaving home yet on the road: who is it? — hears the ritual officer answer: far, a hundred thousand; near, not apart from right here — a shout, a blow: one man blessed, the ten thousand matters at peace, and Dounan Wei at the reception: right at this moment, at home not leaving the road — the on-the-road never-leaving-home line, how does it go? A thousand li come specially to show an old face; meeting, we see each other and laugh.
